data.body: SCOPE-ADDITION (2026-05-20): In addition to the existing dir:<path> tag (which remains the dedup key), every auto-filed advisory ticket must also be tagged with the flat canonical tag 'directory-size-advisory'. This enables cross-cutting queries for SC-7 self-use verification ('ticket list --has-tag=directory-size-advisory') without disturbing the per-path dedup mechanism. See task 0a30-4ef1-70dc-4479 (reconciliation) for full justification. Source: 2026-05-20 implementation-plan remediation against epic c2cc-e3c4 SC↔AC coverage analysis.
